summary: Tested Manuel Telefon Siparişi (Manual Order Creation) feature for ShiftJet Restoran Paneli. All features working correctly including normal order creation, scheduled order creation with 30-minute buffer, product selection, cart management, and order status tabs.

details: ✓ 'Yeni Sipariş' button visible at top-right of Anasayfa dashboard
✓ Modal opens with title 'Yeni Telefon Siparişi'
✓ All form fields present: Müşteri Adı, Telefon, Teslimat Adresi, Sipariş Notu
✓ Payment method buttons: Nakit, Kart, Online
✓ Product selection section with categories and products
✓ Cart (Sepet) with quantity controls (+/-) and delete
✓ Items can be removed from cart
✓ When checked, Date (Tarih) and Time (Saat) fields appear
✓ Fields have correct data-testid: scheduled-date-input, scheduled-time-input
✓ Note displayed: 'Sipariş belirtilen saatten 30 dk önce hazırlanmaya başlar'
✓ Order marked with 'Tel' badge indicating phone order
✓ POST /api/orders/manual with is_scheduled=true creates order with status='scheduled'
✓ 'Hazırlamaya Başla' button available in Programlı tab
✓ Programlı tab shows scheduled orders with scheduled_time column
✓ All tabs have correct data-testid attributes

seed_data_creation: Multiple test orders created during testing with prefix 'TEST_' in customer names. Manual orders created via API and UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manuel sipariş oluşturma (Yeni Sipariş) özelliği tam olarak test edildi. Backend API (/api/orders/manual) ve Frontend modal (NewOrderModal.jsx) düzgün çalışıyor. Normal siparişler 'preparing' durumunda, programlı siparişler 'scheduled' durumunda oluşturuluyor. 30 dakikalık hazırlık tamponu doğru şekilde uygulanıyor.
